build_model_from_config: build a model from a config dict using the BaseStrategy build_model method
build_optim_wrapper: build an optimizer wrapper from a config dict using the BaseStrategy build_optim_wrapper method
build_param_scheduler: build parameter schedulers for an optimizer using the BaseStrategy build_param_scheduler method
compile_model: compile a PyTorch model using torch.compile via the BaseStrategy compile_model method
save_checkpoint: save a training checkpoint with model, optimizer, and scheduler state using the BaseStrategy save_checkpoint method
